def validate_story_quest_definition(quest: StoryQuestDefinition) -> None:
    """Validate one definition without consulting mutable runtime state."""
    _require(_text(quest.quest_id),'quest_id must be non-empty')
    _require(quest.number>0,f'{quest.quest_id}: number must be positive')
    _require(_text(quest.title),f'{quest.quest_id}: title is required')
    _require(isinstance(quest.quest_type,QuestType),f'{quest.quest_id}: invalid quest_type')
    _require(_text(quest.location_id),f'{quest.quest_id}: location_id is required')
    _require(quest.unlock_level>0,f'{quest.quest_id}: unlock_level must be positive')
    _require(_text(quest.giver_npc_id),f'{quest.quest_id}: giver_npc_id is required')
    _require(_text(quest.description),f'{quest.quest_id}: description is required')
    _require(_text(quest.objective_text),f'{quest.quest_id}: objective_text is required')
    _require(quest.target_quantity>0,f'{quest.quest_id}: target_quantity must be positive')
    _require(quest.reward.exp>=0 and quest.reward.gold>=0,f'{quest.quest_id}: rewards cannot be negative')
    if quest.quest_type is QuestType.QUEST_ITEM:
        _require(quest.quest_item is not None,f'{quest.quest_id}: QUEST_ITEM requires quest_item')
        item=quest.quest_item
        _require(_text(item.item_key) and _text(item.display_name),f'{quest.quest_id}: quest item identity is required')
        validate_story_quest_item_key(item.item_key)
        _require(item.required_quantity>0,f'{quest.quest_id}: required_quantity must be positive')
        _require(0<=item.drop_chance<=1,f'{quest.quest_id}: drop_chance must be within 0..1')
        _require(isinstance(item.consume_on_completion,bool),f'{quest.quest_id}: consume_on_completion must be bool')
        _require(quest.target_quantity==item.required_quantity,f'{quest.quest_id}: quantities must match')
    else:
        _require(quest.quest_item is None,f'{quest.quest_id}: quest_item only allowed for QUEST_ITEM')
    if quest.quest_type is QuestType.BOSS:
        _require(_text(quest.boss_key),f'{quest.quest_id}: BOSS requires boss_key')
    else:
        _require(quest.boss_key is None,f'{quest.quest_id}: boss_key only allowed for BOSS')
    if quest.quest_type is QuestType.TURN_IN:
        _require(_text(quest.turn_in_npc_id),f'{quest.quest_id}: TURN_IN requires turn_in_npc_id')
    allowed_consumption = {"default", "none", "atomic_exact_once", "atomic_exact_once_all_or_nothing"}
    _require(quest.quest_item_consumption in allowed_consumption,f'{quest.quest_id}: invalid quest_item_consumption')
    required_keys=set()
    for required in quest.required_quest_items:
        _require(isinstance(required,RequiredQuestItemDefinition),f'{quest.quest_id}: invalid required quest item')
        _require(_text(required.item_key),f'{quest.quest_id}: required item key is required')
        validate_story_quest_item_key(required.item_key)
        _require(required.quantity>0,f'{quest.quest_id}: required item quantity must be positive')
        _require(isinstance(required.consume,bool),f'{quest.quest_id}: required item consume must be bool')
        _require(required.item_key not in required_keys,f'{quest.quest_id}: duplicate required item key')
        required_keys.add(required.item_key)
    if quest.quest_item_consumption == "none":
        _require(all(not item.consume for item in quest.required_quest_items),f'{quest.quest_id}: none policy cannot consume items')
    if quest.quest_item_consumption == "atomic_exact_once_all_or_nothing":
        _require(len(quest.required_quest_items)>1,f'{quest.quest_id}: all-or-nothing requires multiple items')
    if quest.navigation:
        _require(quest.navigation.location_id==quest.location_id,f'{quest.quest_id}: navigation location mismatch')
        _require(quest.navigation.giver_npc_id==quest.giver_npc_id,f'{quest.quest_id}: navigation giver mismatch')
        _require(quest.navigation.turn_in_npc_id==quest.turn_in_npc_id,f'{quest.quest_id}: navigation turn-in mismatch')

def validate_story_quest_pack(quests: Sequence[StoryQuestDefinition]):
    """Validate an ordered pack and return an immutable quest-ID registry."""
    _require(bool(quests),'story quest pack cannot be empty')
    by_id={}; numbers=set(); item_keys=set()
    for index,quest in enumerate(quests):
        validate_story_quest_definition(quest)
        _require(quest.quest_id not in by_id,f'duplicate quest_id: {quest.quest_id}')
        _require(quest.number not in numbers,f'duplicate quest number: {quest.number}')
        if index:
            previous=quests[index-1]
            _require(quest.previous_quest_id==previous.quest_id,f'{quest.quest_id}: invalid predecessor')
            _require(quest.number==previous.number+1,f'{quest.quest_id}: numbers must be consecutive')
        if quest.quest_item:
            _require(quest.quest_item.item_key not in item_keys,f'duplicate quest item key: {quest.quest_item.item_key}')
            item_keys.add(quest.quest_item.item_key)
        by_id[quest.quest_id]=quest; numbers.add(quest.number)
    return MappingProxyType(by_id)

def is_character_name_taken(name, exclude_user_id=None):
    """
    Перевіряє чи зайняте ім'я персонажа іншим користувачем.
    """
    from .connection import cursor
    
    from systems.character_system import normalize_character_name
    
    target_name = normalize_character_name(name)
    
    if not target_name:
        return False
    
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT user_id, character_name
    FROM users
    WHERE character_name IS NOT NULL
      AND character_name != ''
    """)
    
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    
    for row in rows:
        existing_user_id, existing_name = row
        
        if exclude_user_id is not None:
            try:
                if int(existing_user_id) == int(exclude_user_id):
                    continue
            except Exception:
                pass
        
        existing_normalized = normalize_character_name(existing_name)
        
        if existing_normalized.casefold() == target_name.casefold():
            return True
    
    return False

def spend_user_mp(user_id, amount):
    """
    Витрата MP для навичок.
    """
    from .connection import conn, cursor
    
    mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)

    current_mp = mp_data.get("mp", 0)
    max_mp = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)

    try:
        amount = int(amount)
    except Exception:
        amount = 0

    if amount <= 0:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "mp": current_mp,
            "max_mp": max_mp
        }

    if current_mp < amount:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"❌ Недостатньо мани.\n\n"
                f"🔵 Потрібно: {amount} MP\n"
                f"🔵 У тебе: {current_mp}/{max_mp} MP"
            ),
            "mp": current_mp,
            "max_mp": max_mp
        }

    new_mp = current_mp - amount

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET mp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_mp,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "mp": new_mp,
        "max_mp": max_mp
    }

def restore_user_mp_to_full(user_id):
    """
    Повністю відновлює MP, якщо персонаж використовує ману.

    Для не-mana класів нічого не робить.
    """
    from .connection import conn, cursor
    from data.classes import CLASS_CONFIGS
    
    init_character_class_system()

    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
    resource_type = CLASS_CONFIGS.get(class_key, {}).get("resource", "")

    if resource_type != "mana":
        return {
            "success": True,
            "restored": False,
            "mp": 0,
            "max_mp": 0
        }

    mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)
    max_mp = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET mp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        max_mp,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "restored": True,
        "mp": max_mp,
        "max_mp": max_mp
    }

def init_db():
    cursor.execute("""

        user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

        hp INTEGER,

        level INTEGER,
        exp INTEGER,
        gold REAL,
        kills INTEGER,
        bag_slots INTEGER,

        dex INTEGER,
        intelligence INTEGER,
        wis INTEGER,

        equipped_armor INTEGER,

    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id INTEGER,
        item_id INTEGER,
        quantity INTEGER,
        durability INTEGER
    ,
        refine_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT,
        type TEXT,
        rarity TEXT,
        category TEXT,

        slot_key TEXT,
        weapon_hands INTEGER,

        max_stack INTEGER,
        sell_price REAL,

        bonus_str INTEGER,
        bonus_dex INTEGER,
        bonus_int INTEGER,
        bonus_wis INTEGER,
        bonus_sta INTEGER,

        pdef INTEGER,
        mdef INTEGER
    ,
        item_subtype TEXT DEFAULT ''
    ,
        armor_type TEXT DEFAULT ''
    ,
        weapon_min_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_max_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_min_magic_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_max_magic_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_attack_type TEXT DEFAULT ''
    ,
        shop_preview_owner INTEGER DEFAULT NULL
    ,
        shop_preview_price INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equipment_slots (
        user_id INTEGER,
        slot_key TEXT,
        inventory_id INTEGER,
        PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot_key)
    )
    """)

    migrations = [
        ("users", "gold", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "kills", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "bag_slots", "INTEGER DEFAULT 60"),
        ("users", "current_location", "TEXT DEFAULT 'start_path'"),

        ("inventory", "quantity", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("inventory", "durability", "INTEGER DEFAULT NULL"),

        ("items", "category", "TEXT DEFAULT 'equipment'"),
        ("items", "slot_key", "TEXT DEFAULT NULL"),
        ("items", "weapon_hands", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "max_stack", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "sell_price", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "bonus_sta", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "pdef", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "mdef", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "item_level", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "is_generated", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),

        ("users", "registered_at", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "daily_contracts_completed", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "daily_contract_date", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),

        ("users", "energy", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "last_energy_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "energy_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),

        ("users", "last_hp_regen_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "hp_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("users", "daily_hunts", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "daily_hunts_date", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET gold = 0 WHERE gold IS NULL")
    cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET kills = 0 WHERE kills IS NULL")
    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE users SET bag_slots = ? WHERE bag_slots IS NULL",
        (DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS,),
    )  # ROM 17.8.1.1 PARAMETERIZED BAG DEFAULT

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET current_location = 'start_path'
    WHERE current_location IS NULL OR current_location = ''
    """)

    cursor.execute("UPDATE inventory SET quantity = 1 WHERE quantity IS NULL")

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE inventory
    SET durability = 100
    WHERE durability IS NULL
      AND item_id IN (
          SELECT id FROM items WHERE category = 'equipment'
      )
    """)

                conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")

                conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

                    (user_id,),

                        "player_trade_offers",
                        "player_trade_events",
                        "player_trade_history",

    Робить 2 речі:

def apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(stats, armor_type):
    """
    Центральна функція профілю броні.

    Робить 2 речі:
    1. Перерозподіляє PDEF/MDEF залежно від armor_type.
    2. Перерозподіляє основні характеристики залежно від armor_type.
    """

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)

    if not armor_type:
        return stats

    # ==============================
    # 1. PDEF / MDEF redistribution
    # ==============================

    defense_profile = ARMOR_DEFENSE_DISTRIBUTION_PROFILES.get(armor_type)

    if defense_profile:
        base_pdef = int(stats.get("pdef", 0) or 0)
        base_mdef = int(stats.get("mdef", 0) or 0)
        base_total = base_pdef + base_mdef

        if base_total > 0:
            total_multiplier = float(defense_profile.get("total_multiplier", 1.0))
            pdef_share = float(defense_profile.get("pdef_share", 0.5))
            mdef_share = float(defense_profile.get("mdef_share", 0.5))

            total_defense = int(round(base_total * total_multiplier))

            if total_defense < 2:
                total_defense = 2

            new_pdef = int(round(total_defense * pdef_share))
            new_mdef = int(round(total_defense * mdef_share))

            new_pdef = max(1, new_pdef)
            new_mdef = max(1, new_mdef)

            # Гарантія: тканина завжди має MDEF > PDEF.
            if armor_type == "cloth" and new_mdef <= new_pdef:
                total = max(2, new_pdef + new_mdef)
                new_mdef = max(1, int(round(total * 0.70)))
                new_pdef = max(1, total - new_mdef)

                if new_mdef <= new_pdef:
                    new_mdef = new_pdef + 1

            # Гарантія: лати завжди мають PDEF > MDEF.
            if armor_type == "plate" and new_pdef <= new_mdef:
                total = max(2, new_pdef + new_mdef)
                new_pdef = max(1, int(round(total * 0.88)))
                new_mdef = max(1, total - new_pdef)

                if new_pdef <= new_mdef:
                    new_pdef = new_mdef + 1

            stats["pdef"] = new_pdef
            stats["mdef"] = new_mdef

    # ==============================
    # 2. Primary stats redistribution
    # ==============================

    stats = apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats(
        stats=stats,
        armor_type=armor_type
    )

    return stats

def normalize_dev_rarity(rarity):
    rarity = (rarity or "common").strip().lower()

    aliases = {
        "white": "common",
        "білий": "common",
        "bilyi": "common",

        "green": "uncommon",
        "зелений": "uncommon",
        "zelenyi": "uncommon",

        "blue": "rare",
        "синій": "rare",
        "synii": "rare",

        "purple": "epic",
        "фіолетовий": "epic",
        "fioletovyi": "epic",
    }

    rarity = aliases.get(rarity, rarity)

    if rarity not in ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        rarity = "common"

    return rarity

    Повертає словник {slot_key: inventory_id} для всіх слотів екіпірування.
    """
    from .connection import cursor, SLOT_ORDER
    
    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT slot_key, inventory_id
    FROM equipment_slots
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    result = {}

    for slot_key, inventory_id in rows:
        result[slot_key] = inventory_id

    for slot_key in SLOT_ORDER:
        result.setdefault(slot_key, None)

    return result

def get_inventory_entry(user_id_or_inventory_id, inventory_id=None):
    """Return inventory entry with both historical call signatures.

    Supported:
    - get_inventory_entry(inventory_id)
    - get_inventory_entry(user_id, inventory_id)
    """
    if inventory_id is None:
        return _equipment_system().get_inventory_entry(user_id_or_inventory_id)

    user_id = int(user_id_or_inventory_id)
    inventory_id = int(inventory_id)
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT inv.id, inv.item_id, it.name, it.type, it.category, "
        "COALESCE(inv.quantity, 1), COALESCE(inv.refine_level, 0) "
        "FROM inventory inv JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "
        "WHERE inv.user_id=? AND inv.id=?",
        (user_id, inventory_id),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        return None

    values = list(row)
    values[2] = format_refined_item_name(values[2], values[-1])
    values.pop()
    return tuple(values)

def generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(slot_key, item_level, rarity, weapon_hands=1, item_profile=None):
    stats = {
        "bonus_str": 0,
        "bonus_dex": 0,
        "bonus_int": 0,
        "bonus_wis": 0,
        "bonus_sta": 0,
        "pdef": 0,
        "mdef": 0
    }

    # ==============================
    # MAIN HAND
    # ==============================

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, MAIN_HAND_PROFILES["sword_1h"])

        main_stat = profile["main_stats"][0]
        base_multiplier = 1.00

        if profile["hands"] == 2:
            base_multiplier = 1.20

        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, base_multiplier)
        add_stat_value(stats, main_stat, value)

        extra_pool = profile["extra_stats"]

    # ==============================
    # OFF HAND
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, OFF_HAND_PROFILES["shield"])

        if profile_key == "shield":
            stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.35)
            stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        elif profile_key == "warrior_shield":
            # 60% of Knight shield PDEF: 1.35 * 0.60 = 0.81.
            stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.81)
            stats["bonus_str"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.65)
            stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)

        elif profile_key == "talisman":
            stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.35)
            stats["bonus_wis"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.65)

        elif profile_key == "dagger":
            stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.95)
            stats["bonus_str"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)

        extra_pool = profile["extra_stats"]

    # ==============================
    # ARMOR SLOTS
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "helmet":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.40)

        bonus = random.choice(["sta", "wis", "dex"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)
        add_stat_value(stats, bonus, value)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "shoulders":
        # Shoulders use the same primary-stat pipeline as the other armor slots.
        # Source-specific shop/loot resolvers redistribute this raw budget later.
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.00)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.40)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta", "str"])

    elif slot_key == "chest":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.60)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "gloves":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.60)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["dex"])

    elif slot_key == "legs":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.20)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "boots":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["dex"])

    # ==============================
    # JEWELRY
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "necklace":
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.30)
        stats["bonus_wis"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["wis", "int"])

    elif slot_key == "ring":
        stat_choice = random.choice(["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.90)
        add_stat_value(stats, stat_choice, value)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])

    else:
        extra_pool = ["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"]

    # ==============================
    # EXTRA BONUSES BY RARITY
    # ==============================

    if rarity in ["uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        bonus_count = 1
        min_bonus = 2

        if rarity == "rare":
            bonus_count = 2
            min_bonus = 3

        if rarity == "epic":
            bonus_count = 3
            min_bonus = 4

        for _ in range(bonus_count):
            bonus_type = random.choice(extra_pool)

            bonus_value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
            bonus_value = max(min_bonus, bonus_value)

            add_stat_value(stats, bonus_type, bonus_value)

    return stats

def create_generated_equipment_item_for_slot(user_id, item_level, rarity, slot_key, item_profile=None):
    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    if slot_key not in SLOT_ORDER:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий слот спорядження."
        }

    item_level = int(item_level)
    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    if rarity not in ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        rarity = "common"

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "lost": 1,
            "message": "🎒 Сумка переповнена. Предмет не куплено."
        }

    item_profile = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)

    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""
    # Stage 20.6.5b: forced-slot generation must always provide an explicit
    # armor identity. Non-armor slots intentionally keep an empty armor type.
    armor_type = (
        get_allowed_armor_type_for_class(get_character_class(user_id))
        if is_armor_slot(slot_key)
        else ""
    )

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "weapon"

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "offhand"

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1
        name = get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    name = f"{name} {item_level} рівня"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    # Stage 20.6.5: primary stats follow item identity, never recipient class.
    stats = redistribute_identity_primary_stats(
        stats,
        slot_key,
        item_subtype=item_profile,
        armor_type=armor_type,
        chooser=_class_aware_weighted_choice,
    )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    item_id = allocate_generated_item_id(conn)
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        id,
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type
    ))


    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    inventory_id = cursor.lastrowid

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "name": name,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_level": item_level
    }

def apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(stats, armor_type):
    """
    Центральна функція профілю броні.

    Робить 2 речі:
    1. Перерозподіляє PDEF/MDEF залежно від armor_type.
    2. Перерозподіляє основні характеристики залежно від armor_type.
    """

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)

    if not armor_type:
        return stats

    # ==============================
    # 1. PDEF / MDEF redistribution
    # ==============================

    defense_profile = ARMOR_DEFENSE_DISTRIBUTION_PROFILES.get(armor_type)

    if defense_profile:
        base_pdef = int(stats.get("pdef", 0) or 0)
        base_mdef = int(stats.get("mdef", 0) or 0)
        base_total = base_pdef + base_mdef

        if base_total > 0:
            total_multiplier = float(defense_profile.get("total_multiplier", 1.0))
            pdef_share = float(defense_profile.get("pdef_share", 0.5))
            mdef_share = float(defense_profile.get("mdef_share", 0.5))

            total_defense = int(round(base_total * total_multiplier))

            if total_defense < 2:
                total_defense = 2

            new_pdef = int(round(total_defense * pdef_share))
            new_mdef = int(round(total_defense * mdef_share))

            new_pdef = max(1, new_pdef)
            new_mdef = max(1, new_mdef)

            # Гарантія: тканина завжди має MDEF > PDEF.
            if armor_type == "cloth" and new_mdef <= new_pdef:
                total = max(2, new_pdef + new_mdef)
                new_mdef = max(1, int(round(total * 0.70)))
                new_pdef = max(1, total - new_mdef)

                if new_mdef <= new_pdef:
                    new_mdef = new_pdef + 1

            # Гарантія: лати завжди мають PDEF > MDEF.
            if armor_type == "plate" and new_pdef <= new_mdef:
                total = max(2, new_pdef + new_mdef)
                new_pdef = max(1, int(round(total * 0.88)))
                new_mdef = max(1, total - new_pdef)

                if new_pdef <= new_mdef:
                    new_pdef = new_mdef + 1

            stats["pdef"] = new_pdef
            stats["mdef"] = new_mdef

    # ==============================
    # 2. Primary stats redistribution
    # ==============================

    stats = apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats(
        stats=stats,
        armor_type=armor_type
    )

    return stats

def create_generated_equipment_item(
    user_id,
    item_level,
    rarity,
    class_aware_chance=0.0
):
    """
    Динамічний дроп екіпірування з мобів.

    class_aware_chance:
    - 0.0 = повністю випадковий предмет;
    - 0.5 = 50% шанс предмета під клас;
    - 0.7 = 70% шанс предмета під клас.

    Для class-aware предмета:
    - броня отримує armor_type класу;
    - зброя отримує item_subtype, дозволений класу;
    - off-hand отримує item_subtype, дозволений класу.

    Для random предмета:
    - броня отримує випадковий armor_type;
    - зброя/off-hand отримує випадковий item_subtype.
    """

    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()
    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()

    item_level = int(item_level)
    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    if rarity not in ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        rarity = "common"

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "lost": 1,
            "message": "🎒 Сумка переповнена. Екіпірування не влізло."
        }

    try:
        class_aware_chance = float(class_aware_chance or 0.0)
    except Exception:
        class_aware_chance = 0.0

    class_aware_chance = max(0.0, min(1.0, class_aware_chance))

    is_class_aware = random.random() <= class_aware_chance

    if is_class_aware:
        choice = get_random_class_aware_equipment_choice(user_id)
    else:
        choice = get_random_unrestricted_equipment_choice()

    slot_key = choice["slot_key"]
    item_profile = choice.get("item_profile", "")
    armor_type = choice.get("armor_type", "")

    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""

    # ==============================
    # MAIN HAND
    # ==============================

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        if item_profile not in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
            item_profile = get_random_main_hand_profile()

        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]

        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]

        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(
            slot_key=slot_key,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
            item_profile=item_profile
        )

        type_ = "weapon"

    # ==============================
    # OFF HAND
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        if item_profile not in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
            item_profile = get_random_off_hand_profile()

        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]

        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]

        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(
            slot_key=slot_key,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
            item_profile=item_profile
        )

        type_ = "offhand"

    # ==============================
    # ARMOR / ACCESSORIES
    # ==============================

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1

        if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
            if not armor_type:
                armor_type = get_random_loot_armor_type()
        else:
            armor_type = ""

        name = get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    rarity_name = DYNAMIC_RARITY_NAMES.get(rarity, "Звичайний")
    name = f"{name} {item_level} рівня"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        stats = apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            armor_type=armor_type
        )

    # Stage 20.6.5: class-aware chance controls identity suitability only.
    # Stats always follow the selected subtype/armor type/universal jewelry pool.
    stats = redistribute_identity_primary_stats(
        stats,
        slot_key,
        item_subtype=item_profile,
        armor_type=armor_type,
        chooser=_class_aware_weighted_choice,
    )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    item_id = allocate_generated_item_id(conn)
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        id,
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    ))


    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    inventory_id = cursor.lastrowid

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "lost": 0,
        "name": name,
        "rarity": rarity,
        "rarity_name": rarity_name,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "armor_type": armor_type,
        "item_subtype": item_profile,
        "class_aware": is_class_aware,
        "message": f"{name}"
    }

def consume_user_item_by_item_id(user_id, item_id, quantity=1):
    """
    Споживає предмет за item_id (може бути в різних стаках).
    """
    try:
        quantity = int(quantity)
    except Exception:
        quantity = 1
    
    if quantity <= 0:
        return True
    
    if count_user_item(user_id, item_id) < quantity:
        return False
    
    remaining = quantity
    
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT id, quantity
    FROM inventory
    WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=?
    ORDER BY id ASC
    """, (user_id, item_id))
    
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    
    for inventory_id, stack_quantity in rows:
        if remaining <= 0:
            break
        
        stack_quantity = int(stack_quantity or 0)
        take = min(stack_quantity, remaining)
        new_quantity = stack_quantity - take
        
        if new_quantity <= 0:
            cursor.execute("""
            DELETE FROM inventory
            WHERE id=?
            """, (inventory_id,))
        else:
            cursor.execute("""
            UPDATE inventory
            SET quantity=?
            WHERE id=?
            """, (new_quantity, inventory_id))
        
        remaining -= take
    
    if remaining <= 0:
        compact_user_item_stacks(user_id, item_id, commit=False)
    conn.commit()
    
    return remaining <= 0

def sell_all_trash(user_id):
    """
    Продає всі trash предмети з інвентаря користувача.
    Повертає інформацію про продані предмети та отримане золото.
    """
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        inventory.id,
        items.name,
        inventory.quantity,
        items.sell_price
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.user_id=?
      AND items.category='trash'
    """, (user_id,))

    rows = cursor.fetchall()

    if not rows:
        return {
            "sold_items_count": 0,
            "gold_earned": 0.0,
            "freed_slots": 0,
            "details": []
        }

    total_gold = 0.0
    freed_slots = 0
    details = []

    for inv_id, name, quantity, sell_price in rows:
        quantity = quantity or 1
        sell_price = sell_price or 0

        earned = quantity * sell_price
        total_gold += earned
        freed_slots += 1

        details.append(f"{name} ×{quantity} = {earned:.2f} золота")

        cursor.execute("""
        DELETE FROM inventory
        WHERE id=?
        """, (inv_id,))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold + ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (total_gold, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "sold_items_count": len(rows),
        "gold_earned": total_gold,
        "freed_slots": freed_slots,
        "details": details
    }

def run_db_startup_maintenance():
    """
    Run idempotent database maintenance explicitly during application startup.
    """
    from data.balance import REFINE_MATERIAL_MAX_STACK
    
    result = {
        "success": False,
        "refine_material_stack_sizes": None,
        "contract_target_kills": None,
    }

    # Refine material stack sizes fix
    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE items
        SET max_stack=?
        WHERE id IN (401, 402)
        """, (REFINE_MATERIAL_MAX_STACK,))
        conn.commit()
        result["refine_material_stack_sizes"] = True
    except Exception:
        result["refine_material_stack_sizes"] = False

    # Contract target kills migration
    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE user_active_contracts
        SET target_kills=5
        WHERE target_kills > 5
        """)

        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE user_active_contracts
        SET completed=1,
            current_kills=5
        WHERE target_kills=5
          AND current_kills >= 5
          AND reward_claimed=0
        """)

        conn.commit()
        result["contract_target_kills"] = True
    except Exception:
        result["contract_target_kills"] = False

    result["success"] = True
    return result

    """Return weapon profile with stat attack from canonical production APIs."""
    from .equipment import get_equipped_slot, get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id

            "weapon_max_damage": 0,
            "display_attack": 0,
            "weapon_text": "Без зброї",
        }

    physical_stat_attack = get_attack(user_id)
    magical_stat_attack = get_magic_attack(user_id)
    attack_type = resolve_basic_attack_type(character_class)
    stat_attack = magical_stat_attack if attack_type == "magical" else physical_stat_attack
    main_hand_id = get_equipped_slot(user_id, "main_hand")

    if not main_hand_id:
        return {
            "weapon_subtype": "",

            "stat_attack": stat_attack,
            "weapon_min_damage": 0,
            "weapon_max_damage": 0,
            "display_attack": stat_attack,
            "weapon_text": "Без зброї",
        }

    weapon_data = get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id(main_hand_id)
    if not weapon_data.get("is_weapon"):
        return {
            "weapon_subtype": "",
            "attack_type": resolve_basic_attack_type(character_class),
            "stat_attack": stat_attack,
            "weapon_min_damage": 0,
            "weapon_max_damage": 0,
            "display_attack": stat_attack,
            "weapon_text": "Без зброї",
        }

    
    if attack_type == "magical":
        weapon_min = weapon_data["magic_min"]
        weapon_max = weapon_data["magic_max"]
    else:
        weapon_min = weapon_data["physical_min"]
        weapon_max = weapon_data["physical_max"]

    display_attack = stat_attack + weapon_max
    return {
        "weapon_subtype": str(weapon_data.get("item_subtype") or "").strip().lower(),
        "attack_type": attack_type,
        "stat_attack": stat_attack,
        "weapon_min_damage": weapon_min,
        "weapon_max_damage": weapon_max,
        "display_attack": display_attack,
        "weapon_text": weapon_data.get("text"),
    }

def get_user_daily_quest(user_id):
    """Отримує поточний щоденний квест гравця."""
    init_daily_quest_system()
    
    today = get_daily_today_str()
    
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT user_id, daily_key, total_kills, elite_kills, pvp_kills, 
           trades_completed, status, claimed_at

    WHERE user_id=? AND daily_key=?

            "daily_key": today,
            "total_kills": 0,
            "elite_kills": 0,
            "pvp_kills": 0,
            "trades_completed": 0,

        "pvp_kills": row[4],

def get_daily_quest_progress_text(user_id):
    """Форматує текстовий опис прогресу квесту."""
    from data.balance import DAILY_QUEST_REQUIREMENTS
    
    quest = get_user_daily_quest(user_id)
    
    progress_lines = []
    progress_lines.append("📋 **Щоденний Квест**\n")
    
    if quest["status"] == "claimed":
        progress_lines.append("✅ Квест виконано та винагороду отримано!")
        return "\n".join(progress_lines)
    
    # Total kills
    total_req = DAILY_QUEST_REQUIREMENTS["total_kills"]
    total_current = min(quest["total_kills"], total_req)
    total_icon = "✅" if total_current >= total_req else "⏳"
    progress_lines.append(f"{total_icon} Загальні вбивства: {total_current}/{total_req}")
    
    # Elite kills
    elite_req = DAILY_QUEST_REQUIREMENTS["elite_kills"]
    elite_current = min(quest["elite_kills"], elite_req)
    elite_icon = "✅" if elite_current >= elite_req else "⏳"
    progress_lines.append(f"{elite_icon} Еліта: {elite_current}/{elite_req}")
    
    if is_daily_quest_complete(user_id):
        progress_lines.append("\n🎁 **Квест виконано! Отримайте винагороду!**")
    
    return "\n".join(progress_lines)

def process_daily_quest_progress_on_kill(user_id, mob=None):
    """
    Викликається після перемоги над будь-яким монстром.

    Враховуються:
    - звичайні монстри
    - елітні монстри
    - боси, коли вони будуть реалізовані
    """
    from .daily_compat import get_daily_quest_status, reset_daily_quest_if_needed as _reset_canonical_daily_quest_if_needed
    _reset_canonical_daily_quest_if_needed(user_id)

    status = get_daily_quest_status(user_id)

    if not status["exists"]:
        return {
            "updated": False,
            "completed": False,
            "message": None
        }

    if status["reward_claimed"]:
        return {
            "updated": False,
            "completed": False,
            "message": None
        }

    if status["completed"]:
        return {
            "updated": False,
            "completed": True,
            "message": None
        }

    progress = status["progress"]
    target_count = status["target_count"]

    new_progress = min(target_count, progress + 1)
    completed = 1 if new_progress >= target_count else 0

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE user_daily_quests
    SET progress=?,
        completed=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_progress,
        completed,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    if completed:
        return {
            "updated": True,
            "completed": True,
            "message": (
                "📆 Щоденне завдання виконано!\n"
                "✅ Прогрес: 25/25\n"
                "🏛️ Поверніться до Ратуші за нагородою."
            )
        }

    return {
        "updated": True,
        "completed": False,
        "message": f"📆 Щоденне завдання: {new_progress}/{target_count}"
    }

def get_refine_total_armor_hp_bonus_percent(user_id):
    """
    Повертає сумарний HP% бонус від заточеної броні.
    """
    from systems.refine_system import get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent
    from systems.equipment_system import get_all_equipped_items
    
    init_refine_system()
    
    armor_slots = {
        "helmet",
        "shoulders",
        "chest",
        "gloves",
        "legs",
        "boots",
    }
    
    equipped_items = get_all_equipped_items(user_id)
    total_bonus = 0.0
    
    for item in equipped_items:
        slot_key = item.get("slot_key")
        if slot_key not in armor_slots:
            continue
        
        inventory_id = item.get("inventory_id")
        if not inventory_id:
            continue
        
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT
            inventory.refine_level,
            items.rarity
        FROM inventory
        JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
        WHERE inventory.id=? AND inventory.user_id=?
        """, (inventory_id, user_id))
        
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if not row:
            continue
        
        refine_level, rarity = row
        
        try:
            refine_level = int(refine_level or 0)
        except Exception:
            refine_level = 0
        
        if refine_level <= 0:
            continue
        
        total_bonus += float(
            get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent(
                refine_level=refine_level,
                rarity=rarity
            )
        )
    
    return round(total_bonus, 2)

    """

def generate_class_shop_equipment(character_class, player_level):
    """Return canonical read-only class-shop offer descriptors.

    Compatibility API only. This function does not generate random stats, create
    item rows, or create shop previews. Actual preview creation remains owned by
    create_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, slot_key, item_profile).
    """
    from data.equipment_stat_policy import (
        CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES,
        CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        normalize_equipment_class,
    )

    class_key = normalize_equipment_class(character_class)
    try:
        item_level = max(1, int(player_level))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        item_level = 1

    offers = []
    armor_type = CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES[class_key]
    for slot_key in ("helmet", "shoulders", "chest", "gloves", "legs", "boots"):
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": slot_key,
            "item_profile": "",
            "armor_type": armor_type,
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    for item_profile in CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES[class_key]:
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": "main_hand",
            "item_profile": item_profile,
            "armor_type": "",
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    for item_profile in CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES[class_key]:
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": "off_hand",
            "item_profile": item_profile,
            "armor_type": "",
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    return offers

def activate_story_quest(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quest_id: str,
    quest_number: int,
    target_quantity: int,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Insert one ACTIVE quest without committing the caller-owned transaction.

    Repeated activation of the same already-active quest is idempotent. Any
    different existing row or another active quest is a conflict that the
    lifecycle layer must resolve explicitly.
    """
    quest_key = str(quest_id or "").strip()
    if not quest_key:
        raise ValueError("quest_id is required")
    number = _require_positive(quest_number, "quest_number")
    target = _require_positive(target_quantity, "target_quantity")
    now = str(timestamp or utc_now_iso())
    existing = get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_key)
    if existing is not None:
        if existing["status"] == "ACTIVE":
            return existing
        raise StoryQuestConflictError(
            f"quest {quest_key} already has persistent status {existing['status']}"
        )
    if get_active_story_quest(connection, user_id) is not None:
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("user already has an ACTIVE story quest")
    try:
        connection.execute(
            """INSERT INTO user_story_quests
            (user_id, quest_id, quest_number, status, progress, target_quantity,
             reward_claimed, started_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'ACTIVE', 0, ?, 0, ?, ?)""",
            (int(user_id), quest_key, number, target, now, now),
        )
    except Exception as error:
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("cannot activate story quest") from error
    return get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_key)

def set_story_quest_progress(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quest_id: str,
    progress: int,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Set bounded ACTIVE progress while preserving monotonic advancement."""
    row = get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)
    if row is None or row["status"] != "ACTIVE":
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("quest is not ACTIVE")
    requested = max(0, int(progress))
    bounded = min(requested, int(row["target_quantity"]))
    if bounded < int(row["progress"]):
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("story quest progress cannot decrease")
    connection.execute(
        """UPDATE user_story_quests SET progress=?, updated_at=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'""",
        (bounded, str(timestamp or utc_now_iso()), int(user_id), str(quest_id)),
    )
    return get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)

def add_story_quest_item(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quest_id: str,
    item_key: str,
    quantity: int,
    required_quantity: int,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Grant a bounded quest-item quantity only to the matching ACTIVE quest.

    The operation never touches ordinary inventory and returns both the amount
    actually granted and the resulting quantity for user-visible progress.
    """
    delta = _require_positive(quantity, "quantity")
    limit = _require_positive(required_quantity, "required_quantity")
    key = str(item_key or "").strip()
    if not key:
        raise ValueError("item_key is required")
    quest = get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)
    if quest is None or quest["status"] != "ACTIVE":
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("quest is not ACTIVE")
    current = get_story_quest_item_quantity(connection, user_id, quest_id, key)
    resulting = min(limit, current + delta)
    granted = resulting - current
    if granted > 0:
        connection.execute(
            """INSERT INTO user_story_quest_items
            (user_id, quest_id, item_key, quantity, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(user_id, quest_id, item_key) DO UPDATE SET
                quantity=excluded.quantity,
                updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
            (int(user_id), str(quest_id), key, resulting,
             str(timestamp or utc_now_iso())),
        )
    return {"granted": granted, "quantity": resulting, "required_quantity": limit}

Persist every unfinished quest in one exceeded location as SKIPPED.

    Existing COMPLETED rows remain authoritative. Existing SKIPPED rows are
    idempotent. ACTIVE rows and not-yet-materialized AVAILABLE/LOCKED quests are
    finalized without rewards; isolated quest-item rows for the location are
    removed by the caller-owned transaction.

UPDATE user_story_quests
                SET status='SKIPPED', reward_claimed=0, skipped_at=?,
                    completed_at=NULL, updated_at=?
                WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'
candidate_functions.source:
def reconcile_story_location_as_skipped(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quests,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Persist every unfinished quest in one exceeded location as SKIPPED.

    Existing COMPLETED rows remain authoritative. Existing SKIPPED rows are
    idempotent. ACTIVE rows and not-yet-materialized AVAILABLE/LOCKED quests are
    finalized without rewards; isolated quest-item rows for the location are
    removed by the caller-owned transaction.
    """
    ordered = sorted(tuple(quests), key=lambda quest: int(quest.number))
    now = str(timestamp or utc_now_iso())
    completed = skipped_now = already_skipped = 0
    quest_ids = []
    for quest in ordered:
        quest_id = str(quest.quest_id); quest_ids.append(quest_id)
        row = get_story_quest(connection, int(user_id), quest_id)
        if row is not None and str(row["status"]) == "COMPLETED":
            completed += 1
            continue
        if row is not None and str(row["status"]) == "SKIPPED":
            already_skipped += 1
            continue
        if row is not None:
            updated = connection.execute(
                """UPDATE user_story_quests
                SET status='SKIPPED', reward_claimed=0, skipped_at=?,
                    completed_at=NULL, updated_at=?
                WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'""",
                (now, now, int(user_id), quest_id),
            )
            if updated.rowcount != 1:
                raise StoryQuestConflictError("story quest changed concurrently")
        else:
            connection.execute(
                """INSERT INTO user_story_quests
                (user_id, quest_id, quest_number, status, progress,
                 target_quantity, reward_claimed, started_at, completed_at,
                 skipped_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'SKIPPED', 0, ?, 0, ?, NULL, ?, ?)""",
                (int(user_id), quest_id, int(quest.number),
                 int(quest.target_quantity), now, now, now),
            )
        skipped_now += 1
    if quest_ids:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in quest_ids)
        connection.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM user_story_quest_items WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id IN ({placeholders})",
            (int(user_id), *quest_ids),
        )
    return {"completed": completed, "skipped_now": skipped_now,
            "already_skipped": already_skipped, "quest_count": len(ordered)}

def skip_active_story_quest(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quest_id: str,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Mark one ACTIVE quest SKIPPED and remove only its isolated quest items.

    The caller owns commit or rollback, so status and item cleanup can remain in
    the same transaction as the future over-level lifecycle operation.
    """
    row = get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)
    if row is None or row["status"] != "ACTIVE":
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("quest is not ACTIVE")
    now = str(timestamp or utc_now_iso())
    updated = connection.execute(
        """UPDATE user_story_quests
        SET status='SKIPPED', skipped_at=?, updated_at=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'""",
        (now, now, int(user_id), str(quest_id)),
    )
    if updated.rowcount != 1:
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("ACTIVE quest changed concurrently")
    connection.execute(
        "DELETE FROM user_story_quest_items WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=?",
        (int(user_id), str(quest_id)),
    )
    return get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)

def build_attribute_allocation_text(user_id: int, draft: dict | None = None) -> str:


    state = get_attribute_point_state(user_id)


    draft = draft or _get_draft(user_id)


    pending = draft["pending"]


    pending_total = sum(pending.values())


    remaining = max(0, draft["expected_free_attribute_points"] - pending_total)


    lines = [


        "⭐ Розподіл характеристик",


        "",


        f"Вільні очки: {state['free_attribute_points']}",


        f"Заплановано: {pending_total}",


        f"Залишиться після підтвердження: {remaining}",


        "",


    ]


    for name in ATTRIBUTE_ORDER:


        allocated_key = f"allocated_{name}"


        lines.append(


            f"{ATTRIBUTE_LABELS[name]}: розподілено {state[allocated_key]}"


            f" | додати +{pending[name]}"


        )


    lines.extend((


        "",


        "Очки буде розподілено лише після натискання «Підтвердити».",


    ))


    return "\n".join(lines)

def attribute_allocation_kb(user_id: int, navigation_kb_factory, draft: dict | None = None):


    draft = draft or _get_draft(user_id)


    pending = draft["pending"]


    pending_total = sum(pending.values())


    available = draft["expected_free_attribute_points"]


    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=3)


    for name in ATTRIBUTE_ORDER:


        kb.row(


            types.InlineKeyboardButton("➖", callback_data=f"attr:minus:{name}"),


            types.InlineKeyboardButton(


                f"{ATTRIBUTE_BUTTON_LABELS[name]} +{pending[name]}",


                callback_data="attr:noop",


            ),


            types.InlineKeyboardButton("➕", callback_data=f"attr:plus:{name}"),


        )


    if pending_total > 0:


        kb.row(


            types.InlineKeyboardButton("✅ Підтвердити", callback_data="attr:confirm"),


            types.InlineKeyboardButton("❌ Скасувати", callback_data="attr:cancel"),


        )


    else:


        kb.row(types.InlineKeyboardButton("❌ Скасувати", callback_data="attr:cancel"))


    kb.row(types.InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Назад", callback_data="attr:back"))

    return kb

                pending[attribute] += 1

            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

                _render(bot, call, navigation_kb_factory, refresh=True)


                return


            except (InvalidAllocationError, AttributeAllocationError):


                _clear_draft(user_id)


                bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Розподіл не застосовано", show_alert=True)


                _render(bot, call, navigation_kb_factory, refresh=True)


                return


            _clear_draft(user_id)


            bot.answer_callback_query(


                call.id,


                f"Розподілено очок: {result['spent']}",


                show_alert=True,


            )


            _render(bot, call, navigation_kb_factory, refresh=True)


            return





        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "Невідома дія", show_alert=True)

    from db import get_user_sellable_equipment_for_auction

    offset = page * AUCTION_SELL_PAGE_SIZE
    items = get_user_sellable_equipment_for_auction(

    for item in visible_items:
        durability = ""
        if item.get("durability_current") is not None:

        typed_name = _auction_equipment_typed_name_11_4_1(item['inventory_id'], item['name'])

        # Telegram buttons can be large, but keep it reasonable.
        if len(button_text) > 90:
            button_text = button_text[:87] + "..."

        kb.add(button_text)

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append(AUCTION_PREV_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON)
    if has_next:
        nav.append(AUCTION_NEXT_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON)
    if nav:
        kb.add(*nav)

    kb.add(AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON)
    return kb, visible_items, has_next

        state = AUCTION_SELL_STATE.get(user_id) or {}

            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_house_text(user_id),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Виставлення товару скасовано.",
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()

            if text != AUCTION_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORY_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Оберіть категорію кнопкою нижче.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb()
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "item"
            state["page"] = 0
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
            list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=0)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

            page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)

            if text == AUCTION_NEXT_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                page += 1
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=page)

                return

                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=page)

def auction_buy_lots_inline_kb_v1(user_id, page=0):
    from db import get_public_auction_lots_for_buyer

    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    offset = page * AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE
    lots = get_public_auction_lots_for_buyer(
        user_id=user_id,
        limit=AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE + 1,
        offset=offset,
        sort="new",
    )

    visible_lots = lots[:AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE]
    has_next = len(lots) > AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    for lot in visible_lots:
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)
        qty = f" ×{quantity}" if quantity > 1 and f"×{quantity}" not in lot["item_name"] else ""
        label = f"🛒 {_auction_lot_typed_name_17_1_0(lot)}{qty} — {lot['price']} 💰"
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            _auction_inline_truncate(label),
            callback_data=f"ah_buy_lot:{lot['id']}:{page}"
        ))

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("⬅️ Назад", callback_data=f"ah_buy_page:{page - 1}"))
    if has_next:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("➡️ Далі", callback_data=f"ah_buy_page:{page + 1}"))
    if nav:
        kb.row(*nav)

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Торговий дім", callback_data="ah_menu"))
    return kb, visible_lots, has_next

def _auction_register_buy_category_keyboard_cleanup_v1(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text in AUCTION_BUY_CATEGORY_BY_BUTTON_V1)
    def auction_buy_category_selected_clean_keyboard_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        category = AUCTION_BUY_CATEGORY_BY_BUTTON_V1.get(message.text)
        if category is None:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Невідома категорія лотів.",
                reply_markup=auction_buy_category_kb_v1(),
            )
            return
        sort_key = "new"
        page = 0

        text = build_auction_buy_lots_text_v1(
            category=category,
            sort_key=sort_key,
            page=page
        )

        inline_kb, lots, has_next = auction_buy_lots_inline_kb_v1(
            user_id,
            category=category,
            sort_key=sort_key,
            page=page
        )

        if not lots:
            text += "\n\nЛотів у цій категорії поки немає."

        # Важливо: спочатку міняємо нижню ReplyKeyboard на одну кнопку 🔙 Торговий дім,

def _auction_send_sell_category_listing_v1(bot, message, category):
    """Open one sell category through the canonical inline item-list flow."""

    user_id = message.from_user.id
    category = str(category or "").strip().lower()
    allowed_categories = {"equipment", "potion", "material", "rune", "consumable"}

    if category not in allowed_categories:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "❌ Невідома категорія товару.",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb_v1(),
        )
        return

    # A concrete category must never remain in the persistent reply keyboard.
    # The item list itself is always rendered by InlineKeyboardMarkup.
    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        "📂 Категорію відкрито. Для повернення до категорій використай inline-кнопку «🔙 Категорії виставлення» під списком.",
        reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1(),
    )

    try:
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(
            user_id=user_id,
            category=category,
            page=0,
        )
    except TypeError:
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, 0)
    except Exception as error:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            f"❌ Не вдалося відкрити категорію: {error}",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1(),
        )
        return

    if not isinstance(inline_kb, types.InlineKeyboardMarkup):
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "❌ Список категорії має некоректний формат клавіатури.",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1(),
        )
        return

    inline_kb = _auction_sanitize_sell_inline_kb_v1(inline_kb)
    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=inline_kb)

def auction_search_results_inline_kb_v1(user_id, query, sort_key="new", page=0):
    from db import get_auction_lots_for_buy_search

    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    offset = page * AUCTION_SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE_V1
    lots = get_auction_lots_for_buy_search(
        buyer_user_id=user_id,
        search_text=query,
        sort_key=sort_key,
        limit=AUCTION_SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE_V1 + 1,
        offset=offset,
    )

    visible_lots = lots[:AUCTION_SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE_V1]
    has_next = len(lots) > AUCTION_SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE_V1

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    sort_buttons = auction_search_sort_inline_buttons_v1(sort_key)
    kb.row(*sort_buttons[:2])
    kb.row(*sort_buttons[2:4])
    kb.row(*sort_buttons[4:])

    for lot in visible_lots:
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)
        qty = f" x{quantity}" if quantity > 1 and f"x{quantity}" not in lot["item_name"] else ""
        label = f"📦 {_auction_lot_typed_name_17_1_0(lot)}{qty} — {lot['price']} 💰"
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            _auction_inline_truncate(label),
            callback_data=f"ah_search_lot:{lot['id']}:{sort_key}:{page}"
        ))

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("⬅️ Назад", callback_data=f"ah_search_page:{sort_key}:{page - 1}"))
    if has_next:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("➡️ Далі", callback_data=f"ah_search_page:{sort_key}:{page + 1}"))
    if nav:
        kb.row(*nav)

    # Назад до категорій робимо через inline, бо це повернення саме до buy-category screen.
    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Категорії", callback_data="ah_buy2_categories"))
    return kb, visible_lots, has_next

        f"Запит: {query}\n\n"
    )

    if not rows:
        text += "Продажів за цим запитом ще не знайдено."
        return text

    lines = []
    for idx, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        try:
            avg_price = float(row["avg_price"] or 0)
            min_price = float(row["min_price"] or 0)
            max_price = float(row["max_price"] or 0)
        except Exception:
            avg_price = min_price = max_price = 0.0

        last_sale = format_auction_history_date(row["last_sale_at"], with_time=True)

        lines.append(
            f"{idx}. {row['item_name']}\n"
            f"   Продажів: {row['sales_count']} | Середня: {avg_price:.2f} 💰\n"
            f"   Мін: {min_price:.2f} 💰 | Макс: {max_price:.2f} 💰\n"
            f"   Останній продаж: {last_sale}"
        )

    text += "\n\n".join(lines)
    return text

def auction_sell_state_router_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_SELL_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_house_text(user_id),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        if text == AUCTION_CANCEL_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Виставлення товару скасовано.",
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        if step == "category":
            if text != AUCTION_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORY_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Оберіть категорію кнопкою нижче.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb()
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "item"
            state["page"] = 0
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
            list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=0)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

        if step == "item":
            page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)

            if text == AUCTION_NEXT_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                page += 1
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            if text == AUCTION_PREV_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                page = max(0, page - 1)
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            inventory_id = _auction_parse_inventory_id_from_button(text)
            if not inventory_id:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Оберіть предмет кнопкою нижче.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_items_kb(user_id, page=page)[0]
                )
                return

            from db import get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction, validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment

            validation = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)
            if not validation.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    validation.get("message", "❌ Предмет не можна виставити."),
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_items_kb(user_id, page=page)[0]
                )
                return

            snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
            state["step"] = "price"
            state["inventory_id"] = inventory_id
            state["snapshot"] = snapshot
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_sell_price_prompt(snapshot),
                reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove()
            )
            return

        if step == "price":
            from db import validate_auction_price

            price_result = validate_auction_price(text)
            if not price_result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    price_result.get("message", "❌ Некоректна ціна.") + "\n\nСпробуйте ще раз або напишіть ❌ Скасувати.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb()
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "confirm"
            state["price"] = price_result["price"]
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_sell_confirm_text(state["snapshot"], price_result["price"]),
                reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb()
            )
            return

        if step == "confirm":
            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_LIST_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Підтвердіть виставлення або скасуйте дію.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb()
                )
                return

            from db import create_equipment_auction_lot

            result = create_equipment_auction_lot(
                user_id=user_id,
                inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                price=state.get("price"),
            )

            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)

            if not result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося створити лот."),
                    reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
                )
                return

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "✅ Лот виставлено на продаж!\n\n"
                    f"📦 {result.get('item_name')}\n"
                    f"💰 Ціна: {result.get('price')} золота\n"
                    "⏳ Термін: 7 днів\n\n"
                    "Предмет перенесено з інвентаря до Торгового Дому."
                ),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        # Unknown state fallback.
        clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "ℹ️ Стан виставлення товару скинуто.",
            reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
        )

def build_sell_equipment_confirm_text(user_id, inventory_id, page=0):
    item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)
    if not item:
        text = '❌ Предмет не знайдено.'
        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(text='⬅️ Назад', callback_data=f'sell_eq_page:{page}'))
        return (text, kb)
    inv_id, item_id, name, type_, rarity, category, slot_key, weapon_hands, quantity, max_stack, durability, b_str, b_dex, b_int, b_wis, b_sta, pdef, mdef, sell_price = item
    quantity = quantity or 1
    sell_price = sell_price or 0
    total_price = round(quantity * sell_price, 2)
    text = f'💰 Підтвердження продажу\n\nТи точно хочеш продати цей предмет торговцю?\n\n📦 {name} ×{quantity}\n💰 Ціна: {format_gold(total_price)}\n'
    if durability is not None:
        text += f'🛠️ Міцність: {durability}/100\n'
    text += '\n⚠️ Після продажу предмет зникне з інвентаря.'
    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(text=f'✅ Продати за {format_gold(total_price)}', callback_data=f'sell_eq_do:{inventory_id}:{page}'))
    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(text='❌ Назад', callback_data=f'sell_eq_page:{page}'))
    return (text, kb)

def look_around(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        from systems.location_context_system import get_location_context_kind, get_location_context_kb
        context_kind = get_location_context_kind(user_id)
        if context_kind == 'city':
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_city_text(user_id), reply_markup=city_kb())
            return
        if context_kind == 'travel':
            # Collapsing the map does not finish travel. Keep the authoritative
            # travel/map keyboard and never expose hunting controls early.
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                '🚶 Подорож триває. Відкрий мапу, щоб переглянути статус переходу.',
                reply_markup=get_location_context_kb(user_id),
            )
            return
        if context_kind != 'location':
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                '⚠️ Не вдалося визначити поточне місцезнаходження. Відкрий мапу.',
                reply_markup=get_location_context_kb(user_id),
            )
            return
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_main_menu_text(user_id), reply_markup=main_kb())
        send_story_boss_look_around_if_present(bot, message)

def _calculate_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
    mob, player_pdef, player_mdef, player_dex, sta, level
):
    """Preserve normal/elite behavior; route bosses through Stage 15 bridge."""
    if not mob.get("is_boss"):
        result = calculate_mob_attack(
            mob_attack=mob["attack"], player_pdef=player_pdef,
            player_mdef=player_mdef, player_dex=player_dex,
            mob_dex=mob["dex"], sta=sta, level=level,
            attack_type=mob["attack_type"]
        )
        result["boss_turn"] = None
        return result
    turn = prepare_boss_turn(mob)
    plan = turn["action_plan"]
    request = build_boss_damage_request(plan)
    if request is None:
        return {
            "damage": 0, "is_crit": False, "is_dodge": False,
            "dodge_chance": 0.0, "boss_turn": turn,
        }
    result = calculate_mob_attack(
        mob_attack=request["mob_attack"], player_pdef=player_pdef,
        player_mdef=player_mdef, player_dex=player_dex,
        mob_dex=mob["dex"], sta=sta, level=level,
        attack_type=request["attack_type"]
    )
    result["boss_turn"] = turn
    return result
